personality_one_liner: Bersih, terang, dan ramah dengan sentuhan hijau teal untuk memberi rasa aman dan teratur pada pengguna awam.

spacing.rule: Generous padding around content, clear grouping. Use md and lg for inner card padding, xl for screen edges.

dont's: Do not use glassmorphism for this app. Keep it flat and clean for maximum performance on Android.

screens.name: Beranda
screens.purpose: Dashboard showing overview of boarding house occupancy, revenue, and quick actions.

states.loading: Centered spinner with teal brand color.
states.empty: Should not be empty, but show 0 for metrics if no data.
states.error: Card displaying error message with a retry button.

screens.layout: Hero card at the top displaying total income (Pemasukan) with a soft background image and top-to-bottom gradient scrim. Below it, a 2-column grid for occupancy stats (Terisi, Kosong, Menunggak). Then a horizontal scroll of Quick Actions (Tambah Penghuni, Catat Bayar). Followed by a list of recent activities/transactions.

screens.name: Kamar
screens.purpose: CRUD for rooms, showing statuses, types, and prices.

states.empty: Illustration of an empty room with a 'Tambah Kamar' CTA.
states.error: Readable message with a retry button.

screens.layout: List layout. Each list item is a card (surfaceSecondary) showing Room Number, Status (badge), and Price. Floating Action Button (FAB) at bottom right for Add Room.

screens.name: Penghuni
screens.purpose: CRUD for tenants, including capturing KTP photos.

states.empty: Illustration of empty state with a 'Tambah Penghuni' CTA.
states.error: Readable message with a retry button.

screens.layout: List of tenants. Each row has an initial avatar (tinted brandTertiary), Name, Phone, Room Number, and Status. Tapping opens a detail sheet showing KTP photo and full info. FAB at bottom right to add tenant.

screens.name: Keuangan
screens.purpose: Financial reports, expenses logging, and cash flow overview.

states.empty: Empty state illustration with 'Catat Pengeluaran' CTA.
states.error: Readable message with a retry button.

screens.layout: Top section shows a summary card of Net Cash Flow. Segmented control to switch between 'Pemasukan' (Income) and 'Pengeluaran' (Expenses). A list of transactions below. Sticky primary CTA at the bottom to 'Catat Pengeluaran'.

screens.name: Pengaturan
screens.purpose: App settings including PIN/Biometric lock and Backup/Restore.

states.error: Readable message with a retry button.

screens.layout: Simple list of settings options (Security, Backup, Restore). Each row uses an icon (tinted brandTertiary container), title, and chevron/switch. Standard iOS-Native clean list spacing.

hero_dashboard.alt: Bright modern bedroom interior for dashboard background

empty_state_general.alt: Clean empty room with a stool and plant for empty states

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly adhere to the color palette. No blues, no purples. The primary color is Teal (#0F766E).
Since this is an Android-first offline app, prioritize fast, flat components. Glassmorphism is explicitly disabled to ensure snappy performance on lower-end Android devices.
Implement the PIN 4-6 digit / Biometric check on app launch or resume.

For the dashboard hero card, ensure you use the 'hero_dashboard' image with a top-to-bottom gradient scrim (transparent to surfaceInverse) so the white text (onSurfaceInverse) remains highly readable.
All form inputs should use surfaceTertiary background with no borders (or very subtle borders) and labels positioned above the inputs.
Ensure touch targets are at least 44x44pt.
Implement Whatsapp billing message generator using deep linking (e.g., `whatsapp://send?phone=...&text=...`).
Backup/Restore JSON must be implemented using `expo-file-system` and `expo-sharing` or document picker.
Use Phosphor icons consistently across all screens, keeping a single weight/style.
In the Kamar and Penghuni tabs, ensure empty states are implemented as specified taking full screen height with an illustration, text, and action button.
